static_traits.name: 陈贝丽
static_traits.family_status: Lives with family；描述为“家人身材高大”
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past或咨询；此前not yet出现类似学业问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高、能进行自我Reflection；常用“我是笨Student”等标签化自我评价；语气平和但自我评价偏负面

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在学校里难以取得好成绩，因此常常给自己贴上“笨Student”的标签。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些负面想法一直影响我的自尊和整体幸福感；我只是not想再一直对自己感觉很糟。
growth_experiences: 上一学期考试表现not佳后，开始在收到低分或学科学习受挫时将自己贴上“笨Student”的标签；这一经历逐渐Reinforcement了负面自我概念，导致Decreased self-esteem、学习动机减弱，并影响到对舞蹈等活动的兴趣。
长期承受来自家庭学业成就的压力：认为需要达到家人的学业水平以证明自己，因而在Interpersonal relationships中感到紧张与羞愧，选择not向朋友谈及学业困境。

special_situations.event: Failing exams or receiving low grades last semester
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果考试成绩差，就证明我很笨、并且not适合学习
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Studies doubly hard and seeks help from teachers to prove oneself and improve grades
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我太笨了，根本学not会这些内容

special_situations.event: When encountering difficult problems and getting stuck in math learning
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次就not能掌握或立刻学会，就说明我have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets stricter study goals, practices repeatedly, tries to study harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not适合学数学/我注定学not好

special_situations.event: Thinking about or facing family members' higher academic achievements and expectations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到家人的学业水平，就会让家人失望，说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Studies harder to meet family standards, while avoiding discussing studies with friends to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如家人，I let them down

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends involves academic topics, or thinking about telling friends about academic difficulties
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果暴露自己的学业困境，do not人会看not起我、not会理解我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps silent, avoids discussing academic problems with friends

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被家人与他人认可，作为“有能力的Student”被看见
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为愚笨、被羞辱或Being rejected
defense_goal: Maintaining fragile self-esteem by avoiding exposing failure and doubling efforts
Preemptive self-deprecation to reduce the harm from harsher external evaluation

object_relations.self_representation: A student who is not good enough and prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh evaluators who use grades as the only standard (family/significant others)
not会理解、可能看not起自己的同伴

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about or thinking about his exam failures and low scores
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others (including the counselor) may judge me by grades just like my family, thinking I am stupid
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎，倾向于说“They will not understand me”，避免深入细节，适度模糊化失败情境。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When noticing family members' high academic achievements or hearing the thought 'I must reach the family's standards' rise within
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes external rules are absolute, that one must obey them and define value by grades
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use“应该/必须”的句式自我要求，强调达标而非情感需求。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to ask friends for help or talk about academic difficulties
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为敞露困难会带来羞辱和被看not起
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以“我太尴尬，not想麻烦do not人”的理由婉拒交流，用解释性语言淡化求助的必要性。

manifestations: Feeling one must meet the family's academic standards
Making grades the condition of self-worth
有朋友却not愿讨论学业困境
担心not被理解而选择沉默
Loses motivation and enjoyment for activities once liked, such as dancing

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats family members' academic standards as absolute requirements for oneself
use“我必须/应该达到家人的水平”
When grades are low, directly links self-worth to grades

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 预设朋友会看not起自己、not会理解学业困境
Pre-judging others' negative views in social situations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 明明需要他人支持却选择沉默与自我Repression
not与朋友谈学业，独自承受压力

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我标签为“笨Student”，过度苛责与Self-denial
在交流时谨慎，避免暴露not足

exception_events.target_problem: 在学业考试或学习遇到困难时，来访者通常会将自己贴上“笨Student”的标签，Low mood并减少投入学习。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 去年在一次作文任务中取得了高分，与以往低分时的Self-denialnot同，那次体验带来了能力感与自豪。
exception_events.reason: Clue: this task type better fits their own strengths, they were more engaged at the time and made full preparations; the positive feedback provided evidence of ability, so this time a deviation point of a sense of competence and raised self-esteem appeared.

positive_force: There is evidence of ability (high essay score last year)
Willing to seek teachers' help and try new learning methods
Willing to openly participate in counseling and conduct behavioral experiments
Has communicative friend resources（虽暂not yetuse）
negative_force: Comparison with family leads to dependence on external approval
学习受挫时的非黑即白思维使Decreased motivation

target_behavior.behavior: 在收到低分或遇到学习困难时，自我标签为“笨Student”，伴随Low mood与学习回避
antecedent: Thinking of the family's high academic achievements and expectations
target_behavior.core_reason: 过度概括与非黑即白的能力观，并将家庭的学业标准Introjection为自我价值判断
target_behavior.function: 暂时逃避失败与羞耻感，降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 学习Decreased motivation、成绩进一步受影响、Interpersonal tension、对兴趣活动的参与减少

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids discussing academic difficulties with friends or seeking support
antecedent: When interacting with friends involves academic topics
Feeling ashamed after receiving low scores
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被看not起（读心术式预设），害怕暴露not足引发羞辱
target_behavior.function: 避免负面评价与人际not适
target_behavior.consequence: 社会支持not yet被利用，Loneliness感加重，自尊进一步下降
